text: Hosting docs: systemd unit example; fresh install without the mcp bin warning
description: Remaining Commons Hub server steps (ec95c1ad) include a systemd unit; the README only said 'for example from a systemd unit'. And every fresh-clone pnpm install warned that loop-worker's aimparency-mcp bin cannot be linked (mcp/build does not exist before the build). Nothing used the bin name.

status.comment: README 'Hosting It for a Group': systemd unit (User, WorkingDirectory, ExecStart=/usr/bin/env pnpm start, Restart=on-failure) with enable/journalctl lines and a note on --no-build; the unit passes systemd-analyze verify. Confirmed from scripts/run-local-stack.mjs that without a TTY pnpm start asks nothing and loads .env. Removed the unused bin from packages/mcp/package.json (npm pkg delete bin); a fresh clone's pnpm install showed the 'Failed to create bin ... aimparency-mcp' warning on HEAD and none after the change (clean reinstall). If the MCP is ever published (d8e9a2b1), a bin can return with a launcher file that exists before the build.
